consistency: Native Doris UNIQUE KEY merge-on-write and revision sequence column; no transactional or linearizability claim
oracle: Exact bodies and IDs on each fixed replica index; result caches and fallback disabled; native membership/tablet agreement required
acknowledgement: A bulk SQL mutation returns one ACK; no per-row external commit history
storage: Separate retained FE metadata and BE storage PVCs; kind local-path volumes share one Docker VM; no independent backup
initial_faults: containerd SIGKILL of one data-owning BE, prove exit 137/restart with unchanged Pod/PVC identity
operator rollout, require unchanged database Pod identities and restart counts
unrun: SQL drop operation; tested teardown deletes the owned cluster/namespace
